question: {Find the value of } x { if } 8(x)^(1)/(2) = sqrt{6889} + sqrt{4761}
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

√6889 = 83, √4761 = 69

⇒ RHS = 83 + 69 = 152

⇒ 8√x = 152

⇒ √x = 19

⇒ x = 361

**∴ Answer = 361**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

8√x = √6889 + √4761

**Calculation:**

⇒ √6889 = 83 (since 83² = 6889)

⇒ √4761 = 69 (since 69² = 4761)

⇒ 8√x = 83 + 69 = 152

⇒ √x = 152 ÷ 8 = 19

⇒ x = 19² = 361

**∴ The correct answer is 361.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Perfect Squares

6889 = 83², 4761 = 69²

Simplification

Convert roots into integers first

Equation Solving

Isolate √x, then square

Key Insight

Simplify RHS before solving
